FIWeatherWatch v0.1.7 — for testing
===================================

SIDELOAD
  FIWeatherWatch-v0.1.7.prg            -> GARMIN/APPS/
  FIWeatherWatch-v0.1.7-settings.json  -> GARMIN/APPS/SETTINGS/

Or upload FIWeatherWatch-v0.1.7.iq to the store as a Beta release.
Check the footer reads "v0.1.7" before testing.


FIXED SINCE 0.1.6
-----------------
The About page credit ran off both edges of the screen. It read
"ata: Finnish Meteorological Institu" — clipped at both ends. That is
the CC BY 4.0 attribution, the one string that has to be readable in
full, so it now wraps onto as many lines as it needs instead of being
drawn as a single unconstrained centred line.

PLEASE CHECK: swipe to the About page (fourth) and confirm the whole
credit is readable.


ALSO IN 0.1.6, IF NOT YET TESTED
--------------------------------
* 54 sea stations, was 22 — coastal then 14 inland lakes
* An inland lake says "Ei poijua alueella" on the waves page, not
  "ei havaitsevaa poijua" (which means a buoy exists but is quiet)
* Select shows "Päivitetään..." while refreshing
* The glance refreshes at most every 5 minutes


STILL OPEN
----------
* The 14 lake stations are picks from coordinates — say if any is not
  really on boatable water
